description: For agents that can receive webhooks: registers an https URL that Fold POSTs to on every status change of one order (picked up, washing, out for delivery, delivered…). Payload: {event:"order.status_changed", orderCode, state, statusLabel, statusDescription, occurredAt}. Header Fold-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with the returned secret>. Works with the connected account or order code + booking email. Max 3 per order.

email.description: Not needed with a connected account.

name: subscribe_order_updates
title: Get notified when an order changes
